div.div: Suggested action: update forecast at month-end

Suggested monthly rhythm: Week 1 — reconcile receipts and bank/gateway settlements; Week 2 — follow up overdue accounts; Week 3 — review department expenses and pending approvals; Week 4 — compare actuals against budget, prepare next-month cash forecast and close the ledger. AI recommendations should explain the figures they use and never post payments or change student balances automatically.
